files.description: Hourly weather for the city, September 2025 (720 rows, one per hour in time order, no gaps): observed_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), temp_c (degrees C, one decimal; about 2% empty), rain_mm (one decimal), wind_kmh (whole number), sky (clear, cloudy, fog or rain; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: Fill each empty temp_c with the average temperature of the same hour of the day over the whole month, rounded to 1 decimal. `result` should be a Series of all 720 hourly temperatures indexed by the observation time.
intended_computation: Read weather_hourly.csv; for each hour of the day (0-23) compute the mean of the non-empty temp_c values over the month, rounded to 1 decimal; replace each empty temp_c by the value for its hour; return all 720 temperatures as a Series indexed by observed_at.

acceptable_variants.notes: the index may be the timestamp text or parsed timestamps; values that were present stay as they are

notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
